name: UBD Graduate Research Scholarship (UGRS)
amount: BND 1,200/month for 36 months + tuition + visa fees + airfare + up to BND 3,000 research/conference funds
dlText: Per UBD graduate intake; check official page
fields: Any PhD research area at UBD
note: Competitive PhD scholarship for Bruneian and international candidates. Stipend fell from BND 2,200 to BND 1,200/month under the 2026 terms (Sep 2026 intake onward).

name: UTB Graduate Research Scholarship
amount: Programme fees waived + BND 750/month (24 months Master's by research, 36 months PhD) + return airfare for international students
dlText: Per UTB admission window; check official page
note: For full-time research students; Bruneians get priority only in tie-breaks. Recipients may assist with supervised teaching.

name: Monash Global Excellence and Mobility Scholarship (GEMS) – Malaysia
amount: 100% tuition (up to 4 years) + RM2,950/month + up to 9 months study-away at Monash Australia/Indonesia or IIT Bombay
dlText: Applications open for 2027 intake; check official page for closing dates
fields: Any PhD area at Monash Malaysia
note: Flagship PhD scholarship at Monash Malaysia for Malaysian and international students, including a funded study-away period.

name: Monash Malaysia Graduate Research Excellence Scholarship (GRES)
amount: Tuition waiver + RM2,950/month (3.5 years for doctoral)
dlText: Per research intake; check official page
fields: Any PhD area at Monash Malaysia
note: Merit-based research scholarship judged on academic record and research output; externally sponsored applicants need prior approval.

name: Taylor's University Research Scholarships (PhD Scheme A Plus / A / B; Master's by Research)
amount: 100% tuition + RM3,200/month (A Plus), RM2,300 (A) or RM1,900 (B) for 36 months; Master's by research RM1,500/month
dlText: Accepted throughout the year; tied to admission intakes
fields: Science, medicine, pharmacy, engineering, computing (A Plus); all research areas for other schemes
note: Local and international students with a Taylor's offer letter can apply. International enrolment and visa fees are not covered.

name: Sunway University Postgraduate by Research Scholarship
amount: PhD: 100% tuition waiver; Master's by research: 60% tuition waiver (no stipend)
dlText: See Sunway scholarship calendar; requires unconditional offer

eligibility.note: Open to Sunway and non-Sunway graduates; international eligibility to be confirmed with Sunway's International Office

note: Tuition-waiver scholarship for full-time research students, renewed subject to satisfactory progress.

name: Petchra Pra Jom Klao Ph.D. Research Scholarship
host: King Mongkut's University of Technology Thonburi (KMUTT)
amount: Tuition + THB 18,000/month (+4,000 after proposal approval) + THB 150,000 research allowance + overseas research costs, flights, insurance
dlText: Per KMUTT admission round (join.kmutt.ac.th); contact department first

eligibility.note: Thai and international applicants; international applicants must contact the department before applying

note: Supervisor-linked full PhD scholarship at KMUTT, including funding for a research stay abroad.

name: VISTEC Full Scholarship (Master's & PhD)
host: Vidyasirimedhi Institute of Science and Technology (VISTEC)
amount: Tuition + THB 15,000–20,000/month + on-campus housing + research budget; PhD: THB 1m for up to 1 year research abroad
dlText: Several admission rounds per year; check VISTEC admission system

eligibility.note: Full scholarship for all admitted students; confirm eligibility of non-Thai applicants with VISTEC admissions

fields: Chemistry, materials, energy, biomolecular science, information science & technology
note: Research institute in Rayong backed by PTT; every admitted student receives a full scholarship, and PhD students can spend up to a year at a lab abroad.

name: CMU Presidential Scholarship
amount: Tuition + monthly living allowance (check official page)
dlText: Apply in the semester you are admitted; check official page
note: About 200–240 full graduate scholarships a year for Thai and international students; you must be admitted first, then apply.

name: University of Macau PhD Scholarship / Macao PhD Scholarship
amount: MOP 20,000/month for up to 4 years (tuition is deducted from the stipend) + MOP 10,000/year travel allowance
dlText: Submit with your PhD application; check UM Graduate School admission rounds
note: Full-time PhD applicants apply for the scholarship or a PhD assistantship (from MOP 12,500/month) at the same time as the online PhD application.

name: NTUST (Taiwan Tech) Scholarship for International Students
host: National Taiwan University of Science and Technology (Taiwan Tech)
amount: Full: tuition waived + NT$18,000/month (PhD, 3 yrs) or NT$12,000/month (Master's, 2 yrs); partial: NT$12,500 / NT$9,000
dlText: Apply with Spring/Fall admission application; check admission guidelines
note: Merit award for international degree students, reviewed each year on academic and research performance.

name: NCU International Student Scholarship
amount: Up to NT$40,000/month (PhD), NT$15,000 (Master's), NT$9,000 (Undergraduate); or tuition/credit fee waiver
dlText: New students apply with the admission application
note: Monthly stipends (maximums shown) or tuition waivers for admitted international students; stipends are not paid in the first month of each semester or in Lunar New Year month.

name: Ewha Global Partnership Program (EGPP) Scholarship
amount: Full tuition (incl. admission fee) + dormitory fee + stipend
nextText: Fall 2027 round: check Ewha admissions announcements

eligibility.note: Women from developing countries on the OECD DAC List of ODA Recipients, applying through Ewha's international admission

note: Awarded through the special international admission (no separate form); up to 8 semesters (undergraduate), 4 (master's) or 6 (doctoral).

name: KMUTT Rukkhaphitthayaphat Scholarship (with Forschungszentrum Jülich)
host: King Mongkut's University of Technology Thonburi (KMUTT)
amount: PhD: tuition + THB 18,000/month (+4,000 after proposal) + THB 150,000 research allowance + up to 1.5 years at Jülich; Master's: tuition + THB 8,000/month + up to 3 months at Jülich
dlText: Two windows a year: Mar–Jun (1st semester) and Oct–Dec (2nd semester); exact dates not stated

eligibility.note: Listed among KMUTT scholarships for international students; confirm eligibility with admission@kmutt.ac.th

fields: Plant science, robotics & automation, bioeconomy-related fields
note: Joint KMUTT–Jülich scholarship with a funded research stay in Germany. Very few places each year.
